summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a registered direct offering of 2,298,000 Class B ordinary shares at $4.97 per share to accredited investors, without an underwriter. Proceeds before expenses are ~$11.42M. The shares are listed on Nasdaq under SLMT; the closing price on May 20, 2026 was $4.83. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing provides standard risk factors and delivery expected May 27, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event is involved.
